classes_note: Prediction is based on learned textual patterns, NOT definitive truth. Always show 'Potentially' and advise checking a trusted source.
probability_note: score is the SVM decision value; probability shown in the app is sigmoid(score) for display only, not a calibrated probability.

error_handling.empty_input: return no prediction; ask the user to paste a headline or article text
error_handling.missing_model_file: show an error and do not guess a label
error_handling.very_short_input: warn that short text is much less reliable
